# HEIC test fixture

`rainbow-451x461.heic` is copied byte-for-byte from libheif test data at the
immutable upstream revision below:

https://github.com/strukturag/libheif/blob/1a3583bcce77de6d3f8701c0758e3954863681ba/tests/data/rainbow-451x461.heic

- SHA-256: `4b2ce727f093944975f143ba2b39c4c64511b766d94552f8d51a755916e7f983`
- Upstream project and authors: libheif contributors
- Upstream file history: last changed by Dirk Farin in `f1fd74a3a72c324c421005f896d5c87e3b976215`
- Purpose: local interoperability and browser regression testing only

The exact upstream `COPYING` file from revision
`1a3583bcce77de6d3f8701c0758e3954863681ba` is reproduced as
